replacements.before: - The command runs in `<workspace>`, and each file sits in a planning record or a working directory beyond it, so pass each one as an absolute path.
replacements.after: - The command runs in `<workspace>`, and each file sits in a planning record or a working directory beyond it. Supply the paths as [Dependency Files](#dependency-files) defines them.

replacements.before: - `--since` supplies an explicit start for the [window](#scope).
replacements.after: - `--since` supplies the window start in [Report Selection](#report-selection), selecting the [window](#scope).

replacements.after: - `--initiative` selects the initiative filter in [Report Selection](#report-selection). **Examples:** `I08`, `owner/repo:I08`.
